passage.label: Allah revealed if remained straight way given abundant provision; test them therein whoever turns away remembrance Lord put arduous punishment; revealed masjids Allah do not invoke Allah anyone; Servant Allah stood up supplicating almost became about him compacted mass; Say Muhammad only invoke Lord not associate Him anyone; Say indeed not possess harm right direction; Say indeed never protect me Allah anyone should disobey nor find other than Him refuge; but only notification Allah messages whoever disobeys Allah Messenger fire Hell abide therein forever

arabicExcerpts.text: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا
لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابٗا صَعَدٗا
وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا
وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدٗا
قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا
قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا
قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

mainSubject.label: Divine revelation that steadfastness on the way would have yielded abundant provision as a test, while turning away from the Lord's remembrance earns arduous punishment; masjids declared belonging to Allah alone with prohibition of invoking anyone alongside Him; the Servant of Allah standing in supplication nearly overwhelmed by a compacted mass of jinn; the Prophet declaring he invokes only his Lord without association, possessing no power over harm or guidance, finding no protector or refuge besides Allah if he were to disobey; his role limited to conveying Allah's notification and messages, with eternal Hellfire awaiting whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger
